mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_participants (chat_room_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{hostId}, 'HOST')
mapper.select: SELECT cp.user_id FROM chat_participants cp JOIN chat_room cr ON cp.chat_room_id = cr.id JOIN trip_article ta ON cr.trip_article_id = ta.id WHERE ta.id = #{travelArticleId} AND cp.created_at <= ta.recruit_end_date AND (cp.deleted_at IS NULL OR cp.deleted_at > ta.recruit_end_date) AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_participants cp JOIN chat_room cr ON cp.chat_room_id = cr.id WHERE cr.trip_article_id = #{tripArticleId} AND cp.status = 'ACTIVE'
